figure.summary: The figure as the camera saw it: lens perspective kept (near parts enlarged), a close crop instead of a whole body, weight shown by contact and occlusion, focus ranking the parts; layer 1's anatomy and gesture as the check, not the method.

rules.rule: Keep the lens's perspective: parts near the camera are drawn larger; layer 1 canons hold only for parts at the same distance.
Crop close; let the frame cut forms, but keep one line of action running through the fragment.
Contact with the ground is the passage's darkest value (carbon), with grass pressed under the body and crossing its edges.
Focus ranks the parts; blur grows gradually with distance from the focal plane and is larger behind it than in front.
No contour lines on the body; anatomy shows as tone only.

avoid: correcting the lens back to textbook proportions
a crop without a line of action
parts sharp out of focus order
flags: Layer 1's 'hand about a face long' check conflicts with lens perspective when the hand is nearer the camera; perspective wins.
